rationale: The exact nine reviewed shared SQL mutations for Gutenberg download recovery, absence, downloading claims, attempts, retry-after, failure recording, regional ingestion lease acquisition and negative degraded/failed transitions were replaced by fixed private owner state-machine commands. The private legal owner derives local time, verifies current source identity, source enabled status, pending/retry and quarantined fences, active lease token and attempts; it cannot authorize a positive publishing/territory grant or commercial entitlement. All seventeen surviving API canonical SQL literals and functions are identical to the parent and have independent site SHA re-attestation. This is staging-only; production owner disabled and releaseApproval=false; full ingestion QA still needed. Source-only US catalog observation retirement removes three heartbeat/popularity writes without positive rights; all fourteen surviving API sites were re-attested to their exact identities. No production release. Three regional source-state checkpoint statements were subsequently retired behind independently verified private lease and running-ingest guards, preserving eleven unchanged API SQL sites. QA only, production release denied. Two direct US EPUB hydration writes were privately retired with independent R2 EPUB and SHA-256 validation, source rights checks and asset linkage; nine surviving canonical API SQL sites unchanged. Production owner remains locked. Static formatting-only owner call wrapping changes no SQL, grant eligibility, or authority; source SHA and exact site identities were recomputed.
